appearance.title: Άννα
appearance.visualDescription: Νεαρή γυναίκα με κοντά μαύρα μαλλιά, καστανά μάτια, κόκκινο πουλόβερ και λευκά αθλητικά.

pages.bio: Γεια σας! Είμαι η Άννα. Είμαι 22 ετών. Είμαι ψηλή. Έχω κοντά μαύρα μαλλιά και καστανά μάτια. Φοράω κόκκινο πουλόβερ, μπλε τζιν και λευκά παπούτσια.
Ξυπνάω νωρίς το πρωί. Πίνω ζεστό γάλα και τρώω κόκκινο μήλο. Περπατάω στο πάρκο με τον σκύλο μου.

appearance.opener: Γεια σου! Σου αρέσουν τα κόκκινα πουλόβερ ή τα μπλε τζιν;
appearance.prompt: Περίγραψε την Άννα. Τι χρώμα είναι τα μαλλιά και τα ρούχα της;

appearance.title: Μάρκος
appearance.visualDescription: Ψηλός νεαρός με σγουρά καστανά μαλλιά, πράσινα μάτια, μαύρα γυαλιά και τζιν τζάκετ.

pages.bio: Γεια! Είμαι ο Μάρκος, 25 ετών. Είμαι ψηλός και δραστήριος. Έχω σγουρά καστανά μαλλιά και πράσινα μάτια. Φοράω μπλε τζάκετ και μαύρα γυαλιά.
Εργάζομαι σε ένα μικρό κατάστημα. Πηγαίνω στη δουλειά με το κίτρινο ποδήλατό μου. Το Σάββατο παίζω ποδόσφαιρο με τους φίλους μου.

appearance.opener: Γεια! Φοράς γυαλιά ή έχεις σγουρά μαλλιά;
appearance.prompt: Τι χρώμα είναι τα μάτια και τα μαλλιά του Μάρκου; Φοράει γυαλιά;

professions.title: Σεφ Γιάννης
professions.visualDescription: Φούρναρης με λευκή ποδιά που φτιάχνει φρέσκο ψωμί και παραδοσιακά κουλούρια.

pages.bio: Είμαι ο σεφ Γιάννης. Φοράω λευκή ποδιά και καπέλο μάγειρα. Εργάζομαι σε παραδοσιακό φούρνο. Έχω κοντά καστανά μαλλιά.
Φτιάχνω ζεστό ψωμί και φρέσκα κουλούρια κάθε πρωί στις 5. Αγαπώ το καλό φαγητό! Φτιάχνω και γλυκά κέικ.

professions.opener: Καλημέρα! Σου αρέσει το φρέσκο ψωμί ή τα ζεστά κουλούρια;
professions.prompt: Τι φτιάχνει ο σεφ Γιάννης κάθε πρωί στον φούρνο του;

professions.title: Δρ. Σοφία
professions.visualDescription: Γιατρός με λευκή ιατρική μπλούζα και μπλε στηθοσκόπιο.

pages.bio: Είμαι η Δρ. Σοφία. Φοράω λευκή ιατρική ρόμπα και μπλε στηθοσκόπιο. Έχω μακριά καστανά μαλλιά.
Βοηθάω τους ασθενείς να γίνουν καλά. Δίνω χρήσιμες συμβουλές υγείας. Εργάζομαι στο νοσοκομείο της πόλης.

professions.opener: Γεια σας! Πώς είστε σήμερα; Νιώθετε καλά;
professions.prompt: Πού εργάζεται η Δρ. Σοφία; Τι ρούχα φοράει στη δουλειά της;

properties.title: Λέανδρος
properties.visualDescription: Ιδιοκτήτης φωτεινής γκαρσονιέρας με μεγάλο παράθυρο, κόκκινο καναπέ και μικρή κουζίνα.

pages.bio: Γεια, είμαι ο Λέανδρος! Ζω σε μια ζεστή γκαρσονιέρα. Έχει ένα φωτεινό δωμάτιο, κόκκινο καναπέ, μικρό ξύλινο τραπέζι και μεγάλο παράθυρο.
Διαβάζω βιβλία στον κόκκινο καναπέ. Μαγειρεύω μακαρόνια στη μικρή κουζίνα. Το σπίτι είναι ήσυχο και κοντά στο μετρό.

properties.opener: Καλώς ήρθατε! Σας αρέσουν τα μικρά ζεστά διαμερίσματα ή τα μεγάλα σπίτια;
properties.prompt: Ονόμασε 3 πράγματα μέσα στη γκαρσονιέρα του Λέανδρου με απλά λόγια.

properties.title: Ελένη
properties.visualDescription: Μικρό λευκό σπίτι με μπλε παράθυρα και ανθισμένο κήπο.

pages.bio: Γεια σας! Είμαι η Ελένη. Έχω ένα μικρό λευκό σπίτι με μπλε παράθυρα και κήπο γεμάτο κόκκινα και κίτρινα λουλούδια.
Κάθε απόγευμα πίνω κρύο τσάι στον κήπο. Ακούω τα πουλιά να τραγουδούν. Είναι πολύ όμορφα το καλοκαίρι!

properties.opener: Γεια! Σου αρέσουν τα σπίτια με ανθισμένο κήπο;
properties.prompt: Τι χρώμα είναι τα παράθυρα στο σπίτι της Ελένης; Τι υπάρχει στον κήπο της;

character.title: Mia
character.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa.

pages.bio: Hi, I am Mia! I am a kind and friendly person. I have short blonde hair, blue eyes, and a warm smile for everyone.
I love helping my friends. I help my neighbors carry heavy groceries. I share my umbrellas when it rains.

character.opener: Hello my friend! How are you today?
character.prompt: What does Mia do as a kind person? Describe 2 simple actions.

character.title: David
character.visualDescription: Quiet young man smiling kindly while holding open a door.
character.anthem: 🎵 'You've Got a Friend' by Carole King

pages.bio: Hello! I am David. I am a calm and polite neighbor. I have short brown hair and wear clean blue shirts.
I collect packages for my neighbors when they are at work. I water plants when friends travel.

character.opener: Hi! Do you prefer quiet neighbors or energetic friends?
character.prompt: How does David help his neighbors on Maple Street?

hobbies.title: Oliver
hobbies.visualDescription: Red bicycle parked near a green tree in a park.

pages.bio: I am Oliver, 26. My favorite hobby is cycling in the park! I wear a blue bicycle helmet and bright sports shoes.
I ride my bike for one hour every evening. I see green trees and birds in the park. It makes me feel happy and strong.
I want to ride my bike near the ocean one day. I like fresh air, sunshine, and active weekends with good friends!
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 6 AM on Sundays

hobbies.opener: Hello! Can you ride a bicycle? Do you ride in the park?
icebreakers: No, but I want to learn!
hobbies.prompt: Where does Oliver like to ride his bicycle?

hobbies.title: Emma
hobbies.visualDescription: Young woman in a sunhat holding a wooden watering can near potted flowers.

pages.bio: I am Emma! My favorite hobby is growing colorful plants and flowers on my balcony. I wear a big sunhat and yellow gloves.
I water my red tulips and green ferns every morning. Green plants make my home feel fresh and happy!
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up early to water plants

hobbies.opener: Hello! Do you have plants or flowers at home?
hobbies.prompt: What plants does Emma water every morning?

nationalities.title: Kenji
nationalities.visualDescription: Young Japanese man with neat short dark hair, wearing a traditional yukata.

pages.bio: Konnichiwa! I am Kenji from Tokyo, Japan. I have short straight dark hair and brown eyes. I wear dark blue clothes and clean white sneakers.
I live near Shibuya in Tokyo. I ride fast trains to work. I eat hot ramen noodles and green tea ice cream.

nationalities.opener: Konnichiwa! What is your nationality? Where are you from?
nationalities.prompt: What is Kenji's nationality and home country? What food does he eat?

nationalities.title: Sofia
nationalities.visualDescription: Italian woman with brown wavy hair in Rome.

pages.bio: Ciao! I am Sofia from Rome, Italy. I have long dark wavy hair and brown eyes. I love colorful summer dresses and sunglasses.
In Rome, I drink espresso coffee at small cafes. I walk near historical fountains and talk with my family every evening.
My grandmother teaches me how to cook fresh pasta. I love hot pizza with basil and cheese. Eating together is important!

nationalities.opener: Ciao! Do you like Italian pizza or sweet gelato?
nationalities.prompt: Where is Sofia from? What is her nationality and native food?

food.title: Marco
food.visualDescription: Friendly Italian chef wearing a crisp white apron and holding a freshly baked Margherita pizza.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Marco. I love Italian food. I make fresh pizza and hot pasta every day. Tomato sauce and cheese are my favorite ingredients!
Every morning I bake fresh bread. The kitchen smells wonderful. I drink hot espresso and eat bread with butter.
In the evening, I eat dinner with friends. We share big bowls of spaghetti. Cooking for people makes me very happy!

food.opener: Hello! Do you like pizza or pasta for dinner?
food.prompt: Describe Marco's favorite foods and cooking routine using simple words.

food.title: Kenji
food.visualDescription: Young man at a noodle stall holding a bowl of steaming ramen with green onions and eggs.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Kenji. I eat hot ramen noodles every week. I like warm soup, green onions, and fresh eggs in my bowl.
After lunch, I drink hot green tea. It is fresh and healthy. I do not add sugar or milk to my tea.
On weekends, I make simple rice rolls with cucumber and salmon. Fresh fish and rice make a great lunch snack!

food.opener: Hi! Do you prefer hot ramen soup or fresh sushi rolls?
food.prompt: Talk about Kenji's favorite Japanese dishes and tea habits.

travel.title: Lucas
travel.visualDescription: Relaxed traveler wearing a sun hat and sunglasses on a bright sandy beach with turquoise blue ocean water.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Lucas. I love warm sunny beaches! I swim in the blue sea and walk on white sand. Summer is my favorite time to travel.
redFlags: ✗ Sleeps on the beach all day

pages.bio: I take one small bag when I travel. I pack t-shirts, shorts, and sunglasses. Traveling light makes moving easy and fast!
On holiday, I eat sweet ice cream and drink cold coconut water. Sitting near the ocean waves makes me feel happy and calm.

travel.opener: Hello! Do you like sunny beach holidays or cold mountain trips?
travel.prompt: Describe Lucas's beach vacation habits using simple A0-A1 vocabulary.

travel.title: Sophia
travel.visualDescription: Cheerful traveler holding a camera and map in front of an ancient castle on a cobblestone street.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Sophia. I visit old European cities. I like looking at tall castles, old bridges, and beautiful street lamps.
I carry a small camera everywhere. I take pictures of old buildings, colorful flowers, and happy people in the town square.
I read paper maps and walk through narrow streets. I like finding small local bakeries and buying fresh fruit juice.

travel.opener: Hi! Do you like taking photos of castles or reading travel maps?
travel.prompt: Talk about Sophia's city tours and photography habits in basic English.

entertainment.title: Maya
entertainment.visualDescription: Happy movie fan holding a large bucket of popcorn inside a brightly lit movie theater.
entertainment.anthem: 🎵 'Can't Stop the Feeling!' by Justin Timberlake

pages.bio: Hi! I am Maya. I love watching movies at the cinema! Animated films and funny comedies make me laugh. Popcorn is my favorite movie snack.
I listen to pop music on my headphones every day. I sing sweet songs while I clean my room or walk to school.
In the evening, I read colorful comic books and graphic novels. The big pictures help me learn new stories easily.

entertainment.opener: Hello! Do you like watching animated movies or reading comic books?
entertainment.prompt: Describe Maya's entertainment habits, favorite movie snacks, and musical taste.

entertainment.title: Leo
entertainment.visualDescription: Young musician smiling while playing an acoustic guitar on a wooden bench.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Leo. I play the acoustic guitar. I know many simple songs. Playing music for my friends makes me very happy!
I turn on the radio every morning. I like listening to old rock music and catchy pop radio hits while drinking tea.
On Sunday afternoons, I watch fun action movies on TV. Fast cars, superheroes, and big explosions are exciting!

entertainment.opener: Hi! Do you play a musical instrument or listen to the radio?
entertainment.prompt: Talk about Leo's guitar playing, musical preferences, and Sunday movie choices.

daily_habits.title: Emma
daily_habits.visualDescription: Bright early riser smiling with a cup of morning tea beside an open sunlit window.
daily_habits.anthem: 🎵 'Here Comes the Sun' by The Beatles

pages.bio: Hi! I am Emma. I wake up early at 6 AM every day. I drink hot green tea and open my windows to let in fresh morning air.
redFlags: ✗ Makes noise early in the morning

pages.bio: After breakfast, I walk in the green park for 30 minutes. I listen to birds sing and say hello to neighbor dogs.
Before I go to sleep, I read a simple book for 15 minutes. I turn off my phone and sleep very peacefully.

daily_habits.opener: Hello! Are you an early morning bird or a late night owl?
daily_habits.prompt: Describe Emma's morning routine, walking habits, and early sleep schedule.

daily_habits.title: Noah
daily_habits.visualDescription: Night owl working on a laptop with soft desk lamp lighting and music headphones.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Noah. I like the night! I stay awake until 1 AM reading or playing games. Quiet nights are peaceful for me.
I go to the gym at 8 PM after dinner. Lifting weights and running on the treadmill keeps me strong and healthy.
Every evening, I write my simple to-do list for tomorrow in a notebook. Organizing my day helps me stay calm.

daily_habits.opener: Hi! Do you prefer going to the gym in the morning or in the evening?
daily_habits.prompt: Talk about Noah's night owl habits, evening gym workout, and daily notebook planning.

grammar_present.title: Emma (Daily Routine)
grammar_present.visualDescription: Friendly baker wearing a white apron holding fresh toast and hot coffee in a bright morning kitchen.
grammar_present.anthem: 🎵 'Here Comes the Sun' by The Beatles

pages.bio: I am a baker. I live in London. I wake up at 6 AM every day, eat fresh toast, and drink hot coffee. I love my morning routine!

grammar_present.opener: Hello! I wake up at 6 AM every day. What time do you wake up?
icebreakers: I drink hot tea in the morning!
I live in a big city!
grammar_present.prompt: Prompt (Present Simple): Describe your daily routine. What do you do every morning?

grammar_present.title: Liam (Right Now)
grammar_present.visualDescription: Young man standing near a park in a red jacket holding a steaming mug under gentle rain.
grammar_present.anthem: 🎵 'Singin' in the Rain' by Gene Kelly

pages.bio: Look at me! I am standing near the park right now. I am wearing a bright red jacket and I am drinking warm cocoa. Rain is falling gently.

grammar_present.opener: Hi! I am drinking warm cocoa right now. What are you doing at this moment?
icebreakers: I am studying English right now!
I am sitting in a cafe!
grammar_present.prompt: Prompt (Present Continuous): What are you wearing right now? What is happening around you?

appearance.title: Έλενα
appearance.visualDescription: Athletic woman with shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles, wearing a navy blue striped shirt.

pages.bio: Είμαι η Έλενα, 24 ετών. Έχω μέτριο ανάστημα και είμαι δραστήρια επειδή γυμνάζομαι καθημερινά. Έχω σπαστά καστανά μαλλιά και φακίδες. Μου αρέσουν τα ριγέ μπλουζάκια και τα άνετα τζιν.
redFlags: ✗ Hair gets messy in the wind

pages.bio: Every morning I go jogging along the river path. I drink fresh orange juice and eat oats. Staying moving helps me feel happy and productive all afternoon.
I prefer natural looks over heavy makeup. Comfortable clothes make me feel confident. I love bright sunny days when I can spend hours outside!

appearance.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for casual clothes?
appearance.prompt: Describe Elena's hair, eyes, and clothing style using simple A2 sentences.

appearance.title: Liam
appearance.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair and sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer.

pages.bio: I am Liam, 27 years old. I am tall with short blonde hair and blue eyes. I usually wear well-fitted jackets, dark trousers, and clean leather shoes.
I work in a city bank during the week. In the evening, I enjoy visiting quiet coffee shops with a good newspaper or meeting colleagues for dinner.

appearance.opener: Hello! Do you prefer smart clothes for work or cozy hoodies?
appearance.prompt: How tall is Liam? What does he wear for his job?

professions.title: Nina
professions.visualDescription: Creative designer sitting with a drawing tablet, stylus pen, and colorful art posters.

pages.bio: I am Nina, a graphic designer. I make colorful logos, posters, and websites on my computer. I have dark hair, round glasses, and a creative style.
greenFlags: ✓ Can work from home or cafes
✓ Sees her art in the city

pages.bio: I start my workday with a notebook and sketchpens. I try different color schemes and fonts until the design looks balanced and clear.
Design should be simple, colorful, and helpful for people. I love art galleries, clean typography, and modern city architecture.

professions.opener: Hey! What color combination do you like for a website?
professions.prompt: What tools does Nina use for her work? Why does she like her job?

professions.title: Sam
professions.visualDescription: Smiling barista pouring artful milk foam into a hot cappuccino at a wooden coffee bar.

pages.bio: I am Sam, a coffee barista at a popular neighborhood café. I prepare espresso drinks, roast coffee beans, and draw heart shapes in milk foam.
My shift starts early. I greet regular customers by name and make their favorite drinks quickly before they travel to work.

professions.opener: Hi! Do you drink espresso coffee or herbal tea in the morning?
professions.prompt: What does Sam do as a barista in the morning?

properties.title: Λουκάς
properties.visualDescription: Owner of an industrial loft with high concrete ceilings, large glass windows, and kitchen island.

pages.bio: Είμαι ο Λουκάς. Έχω ένα όμορφο παραδοσιακό διαμέρισμα στην παλιά πόλη. Έχει δύο φωτεινά δωμάτια, ξύλινα πατώματα και μεγάλη ταράτσα με λουλούδια και θέα στη θάλασσα.
I enjoy cooking dinner in the open kitchen while listening to jazz music. Sunlight fills the main room all morning, making it great for plants.

properties.opener: Hi! Do you like big loft apartments with city views?

properties.title: Grace
properties.visualDescription: Two-story suburban family house with a green lawn, wooden porch, and garage.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Grace. I live in a comfortable two-story house with three bedrooms, a large green lawn, and a private driveway.
I enjoy hosting weekend barbecues on the back porch. The neighborhood is safe and peaceful with wide streets and tall trees.

properties.opener: Hello! Would you prefer living in a quiet suburban house or a city flat?
properties.prompt: List 3 advantages of living in Grace's suburban house.

character.title: Sophia
character.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks in a paper planner at her clean desk.

pages.bio: I am Sophia. I am organized and always arrive on time because I plan my days with a digital calendar. I like clean spaces and clear rules.
Every Sunday I make a plan for my week. I organize my tasks, prepare healthy meals, and list all my appointments in color-coded files.
Order brings peace to life. When everything is organized, I feel calm and ready to help my family and friends with their goals.

character.opener: Hi! Do you like to plan your week ahead or make quick decisions?
character.prompt: Why is Sophia a reliable friend? Mention two habits she has.

character.title: Alex
character.visualDescription: Energetic friend laughing while inviting people to a spontaneous weekend road trip.
character.anthem: 🎵 'Best Day of My Life' by American Authors

pages.bio: I am Alex! I am cheerful, energetic, and spontaneous. I love planning surprise weekend trips, trying new street food, and making people laugh.
I often call my friends on Friday evening to suggest driving to the beach or visiting a food festival. Life is full of exciting moments!

character.opener: Hey! Do you like unexpected weekend trips or planned schedules?
character.prompt: Why is Alex a fun friend to hang out with? Give two examples.

hobbies.title: Hannah
hobbies.visualDescription: Golden loaf of sourdough bread on a wooden cutting board with a knife.

pages.bio: I am Hannah and I love baking bread at home. I mix simple flour, water, and yeast, then bake it in a hot oven until the crust is golden.
Baking requires patience. I knead the dough by hand for ten minutes and let it rise twice. My kitchen smells wonderful when bread is baking.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up early to knead dough

hobbies.opener: Fresh bread from the oven! Do you prefer butter or olive oil?
hobbies.prompt: What simple ingredients does Hannah use to bake bread?

hobbies.title: Tom
hobbies.visualDescription: Young photographer looking through a digital camera lens on a city bridge.
hobbies.film: 🎬 'The Secret Life of Walter Mitty' (Ben Stiller)

pages.bio: I am Tom and my hobby is urban photography. I walk through city streets with my camera to capture interesting buildings, reflections, and sunset lights.
During golden hour in the evening, I take photos of historic bridges and busy street corners. Photography helps me appreciate daily city details.

hobbies.opener: Hi! Do you take photos with a digital camera or your smartphone?
hobbies.prompt: What does Tom capture with his camera during evening walks?

nationalities.title: Mateo
nationalities.visualDescription: Mexican man in an embroidered shirt holding corn tacos in a town square.

pages.bio: Hola! I am Mateo from Oaxaca, Mexico. I am proud of my country and traditions. We celebrate festivals with colorful flowers, music, and fresh corn tacos.
I work in a local craft market. During breaks, I chat with neighbors and drink traditional chocolate drinks made with cinnamon and hot milk.
Family gatherings are the center of life in Oaxaca. We play guitars, share home-cooked meals, and celebrate life with lots of laughter and dancing.

nationalities.opener: Hola! Do you like spicy food or traditional festivals?
nationalities.prompt: Where is Mateo from? What food does he make at home?

nationalities.title: Freja
nationalities.visualDescription: Danish woman riding a bicycle along Copenhagen harbor in a sweater.

pages.bio: Hej! My name is Freja. I am Danish and I live in Copenhagen, Denmark. In Denmark, we like cozy indoor spaces with candles, soft blankets, and warm drinks.
I ride my bicycle to my university every morning, even when rain or cold wind arrives. We wear warm waterproof coats and ride everywhere together.

nationalities.opener: Hej! Do you like riding bicycles in the city or taking café breaks?
nationalities.prompt: What country is Freja from? How does she travel around her city?

food.title: Chloe
food.visualDescription: Charming pastry enthusiast holding a plate of golden croissants and sweet macaroons outside a bakery.
food.anthem: 🎵 'La Vie en Rose' by Édith Piaf

pages.bio: Hi, I'm Chloe! I work near a French bakery. I buy buttery croissants and fruit tarts every weekend. Baking sweet desserts is my passion.
redFlags: ✗ Spends too much money on cakes

pages.bio: In the morning, I sit at small outdoor cafés with a cappuccino and a warm croissant. I enjoy watching people walk by while eating.
redFlags: ✗ Gets upset if coffee is cold

pages.bio: I love dark chocolate and raspberry macarons. Cooking desserts for my friends brings everyone together on Sunday afternoons.

food.opener: Bonjour! Do you prefer sweet pastries or savory breakfasts in the morning?
food.prompt: Describe Chloe's bakery visits and morning café preferences in simple A2 sentences.

food.title: Carlos
food.visualDescription: Enthusiastic home cook squeezing fresh lime over spicy street tacos at an outdoor grill.

pages.bio: I'm Carlos, 27. Every Saturday I host street taco nights. I grill marinated beef and chicken with fresh cilantro, onions, and lime juice.
I make fresh guacamole with ripe avocados, tomatoes, and garlic. Eating chips and dip with friends while watching football is ideal.
I believe good food needs rich spices and bold flavors. I enjoy discovering food trucks in different neighborhoods across the city.

food.opener: Hey there! How spicy do you like your salsa and tacos?
food.prompt: Write about Carlos's taco nights, fresh ingredients, and love for street food.

travel.title: Mateo
travel.visualDescription: Active hiker wearing a red jacket and backpack standing on a high mountain summit overlooking green valleys.
travel.anthem: 🎵 'I'm Gonna Be (500 Miles)' by The Proclaimers

pages.bio: Hi! I'm Mateo, 26. I love trekking in the mountains on weekends. Fresh air, green pine forests, and rocky trails make me feel active and healthy.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 4 AM to hike

pages.bio: I set up tents near mountain lakes and sleep under the stars. Cooking campfire meals and telling stories at night is my ideal weekend.
I pack warm jackets, water bottles, and reliable hiking boots. Exploring wilderness trails gives me energy for the work week ahead.
redFlags: ✗ No cell phone signal on trips

travel.opener: Hey! Do you prefer hiking up mountains or relaxing in hotel resorts?
travel.prompt: Describe Mateo's hiking adventures, camping trips, and love for nature.

travel.title: Elena
travel.visualDescription: Enthusiastic train traveler sitting by a window seat watching scenic green hills roll past.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Elena. I prefer taking trains instead of flying. Watching green landscapes pass by the window while listening to music is so peaceful.
I stay in cozy budget hostels and meet travelers from around the world. Sharing travel tips and cooking together in shared kitchens is fun.
When I arrive in a new town, I rent a bicycle and explore local markets, quiet parks, and neighborhood art galleries.

travel.opener: Hi! Do you enjoy long scenic train trips or fast airplane flights?
travel.prompt: Write about Elena's preference for train travel and budget hostel experiences in A2 level.

entertainment.title: Oliver
entertainment.visualDescription: Thoughtful young man wearing large over-ear headphones and holding a vinyl record album in a record shop.

pages.bio: Hi! I'm Oliver, 25. I collect classic vinyl records from vintage music stores. Warm analog sound on a turntable is much better than digital streaming.
I spend cozy rainy evenings reading epic fantasy book series. Immersing myself in magical worlds with dragons and wizards helps me relax.
I love watching science fiction films with space travel and time loops. Discussing movie theories with friends after the film is the best part.

entertainment.opener: Hey! Do you prefer listening to vinyl records or reading fantasy novels?
entertainment.prompt: Write about Oliver's vinyl record collection, reading habits, and sci-fi film discussions.

entertainment.title: Zara
entertainment.visualDescription: Energetic drama fan holding ticket stubs outside a bustling downtown theater.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Zara. I love live theater and Broadway musicals! Singing along to dramatic soundtrack albums brings so much joy and energy.
I read suspenseful detective mystery books before sleeping. Trying to guess the secret murderer before the final chapter is exciting!
Going to stadium pop concerts with colorful light shows and thousands of cheering fans is my favorite weekend activity.

entertainment.opener: Hi! Do you like live stage musicals or solving detective mystery books?
entertainment.prompt: Describe Zara's passion for theater musicals, mystery novels, and live pop concerts.

daily_habits.title: Chloe
daily_habits.visualDescription: Serene yoga practitioner sitting on a mat doing morning stretching in a bright room with houseplants.

pages.bio: Hi, I'm Chloe! Every morning at 7 AM I do 20 minutes of yoga and gentle stretching on my mat. Starting the day with deep breathing keeps me calm and focused.
redFlags: ✗ Yoga mat takes up room space

pages.bio: For breakfast, I blend fresh spinach, banana, almond milk, and chia seeds. Eating healthy whole foods gives me lasting energy throughout my workday.

properties.title: Arthur
properties.visualDescription: Historic paper mill converted into a luxury loft with exposed red brick, heavy timber beams, and river views.

hobbies.title: Φωτεινή
hobbies.visualDescription: Climber wearing chalk bag, gripping indoor bouldering holds on an overhang wall.

I spend three evenings a week at the local climbing gym analyzing route angles with gym buddies. Working out a difficult climbing sequence feels like solving a physical riddle.

hobbies.visualDescription: Amateur astronomer adjusting a telescope under a dark night sky dotted with constellations.
hobbies.anthem: 🎵 'A Sky Full of Stars' by Coldplay

pages.bio: I'm Nora. Amateur astronomy is my passion! On clear nights, I drive to dark sky reserves with my reflector telescope to observe planetary rings, nebulae, and star clusters.
Tracking celestial movements teaches you patience and perspective. Seeing Saturn's rings clearly through your own lens is an awe-inspiring experience.

hobbies.opener: Hey! Have you ever looked at planets or nebulae through a telescope?
icebreakers: I want to see Saturn's rings!
hobbies.prompt: Explain what equipment Nora uses and what she observes in the night sky.

redFlags: ✗ Long debates about who cooks the best rice

nationalities.visualDescription: Indian man in a blue kurta near Jaipur monuments holding cardamom chai.

pages.bio: Namaste! I'm Aarav from Jaipur, India. India is famous for colorful festivals, ancient palaces, and delicious spices. In Indian culture, welcoming guests is very important. I drink warm cardamom tea every morning.
greenFlags: ✓ Knows how to cook with rich spices

pages.bio: I work in textile design, preserving traditional block-printing patterns passed down through generations. Every morning starts with fresh spiced chai brewed with real ginger and cardamom.
redFlags: ✗ Gets passionate about cricket match umpire decisions

food.title: Amina
food.visualDescription: Warm home cook serving fragrant tagine stew seasoned with saffron and almonds from a clay vessel.

pages.bio: I'm Amina, 28. I specialize in slow-cooked Moroccan tagines with chickpeas, tender lamb, apricot, and cinnamon. Slow cooking brings out deep, comforting flavors that warm the soul.
I frequently visit local spice markets to source authentic saffron, cumin, and cardamom. Combining unusual savory and sweet elements creates memorable dining experiences.
After dinner, I serve sweet fresh mint tea poured high into decorative glasses. Food is meant to be a slow, shared celebration rather than a rushed daily chore.

food.title: Liam
food.visualDescription: Health-conscious farm-to-table enthusiast preparing a colorful organic Buddha bowl with quinoa and avocado.

pages.bio: I'm Liam, 29. I advocate for sustainable farm-to-table eating. My kitchen is filled with colorful bowls of quinoa, roasted sweet potatoes, kale, and homemade tahini dressing.
I grow my own heirloom tomatoes, basil, and microgreens in a community garden plot. Eating produce harvested just an hour prior completely changes your perspective on food.
My mornings start with a nutrient-dense spinach, ginger, and spirulina smoothie. Staying healthy gives me boundless energy for outdoor hiking weekend trips.

food.opener: Hi! Are you interested in plant-based organic food or traditional comfort meals?
food.prompt: Explain Liam's farm-to-table philosophy and the benefits of organic plant-based diets.

travel.film: 🎬 'The Secret Life of Walter Mitty' (Ben Stiller)

travel.title: Freja

Photographing auroras and constellations beneath crisp Arctic night skies requires patience, tripod setups, and sub-zero thermal gear.

I commute to work by bicycle year-round regardless of weather. Pedaling through urban streets keeps me physically fit while eliminating my transportation carbon footprint.
